component.name: Paramaja
component.summary: Play any video, with HDR tonemapping and magnet streaming

description.p: Paramaja plays what mpv and VLC play, HEVC and 10-bit included, and keeps out of the way: one window, controls that hide when you are watching, and a welcome screen that takes a dropped file or a pasted magnet link.
HDR films are tonemapped to SDR on the fly, scene by scene, so they look right on an ordinary monitor. On an HDR display, one key switches to passthrough instead.
Paste a magnet link and it starts playing in seconds. Only the file you are watching is downloaded, prioritised around the playhead, so seeking works as it would on a local file.

ul.li: HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision tonemapped to SDR, or passed through to an HDR display
Magnet link streaming, with a choice of file when a torrent has several
Volume is never normalised; 5.1 and 7.1 are kept unless you ask for a stereo downmix
Embedded and external subtitles, auto-loaded by file name
Lossless, uncompressed PNG screenshots at the video's own resolution
Automatic deinterlacing, only for interlaced content

description.p: Titles and chapters menu; menus show only the options the playing video can use; HEVC-only hardware decoding; double-click fullscreen on Windows
Fixes an error when closing the window on Windows, and support for older system libmpv on Linux
Fullscreen controls bar now really sits on the bottom edge on Linux/KDE
In fullscreen the controls bar sits on the bottom edge of the screen again, with no strip of video below it
Open folders, DVDs and Blu-rays, download YouTube videos, automatic HDR
Smooth 4K on weaker GPUs: Auto rendering uses a lighter profile for 4K
Fixes and additions from the first round of testing.

ul.li: Controls come back when you move the mouse, including in fullscreen
BWDIF or Bob deinterlacing, logarithmic volume, subtitle font size shown
Faster magnet streaming for 4K HDR, with a bigger buffer before playback starts
YouTube and other sites, MEGA file links and direct video URLs
Optional AV-receiver passthrough; the original audio plays by default
HDR to SDR tonemapping with scene-adaptive brightness, and HDR passthrough
Magnet link streaming that downloads only the file being watched
Optional 5.1/7.1 stereo downmix, with volume never normalised
Uncompressed PNG screenshots, frame stepping and automatic deinterlacing
